reviews.title: A very well built and solid case. I am looking forward to more cases from this brand.
reviews.comment:
A very well built and solid case. I am looking forward to more cases from this brand.
Well painted, and solidly built. I was expecting fit and finish errors, but found NONE. The three panes of glass meet perfectly and did not require you to adjust them at all.
What I like the most, a "fish tank" case that allows full ATX components without that three fans up and three fans across. Which is not needed at all in most builds.
This case allows a 240mm AIO rad, but you do have to remove the front control panels (three screws is all) to place them. Very easy. Great cable routing with hold downs everywhere.
Plenty of ventilation.
Since this case allows it to sit right or left side, it comes with adhesive feet for the back panel.  Which fell off within minutes. Luckily I have the perfect screw/nuts to mount them by drilling holes where needed. I do not consider this a downside, because there is no better options I can think of.
I will eventually make some wood feet for it.
That is about it, see the pics below.
Good Job, a very fine case.

reviews.title: " " " Affordable " " " AM5 Beast
reviews.comment:
The Good:
- extremely detailed enthusiast board with seemingly endless configuration options
- top of the line features for futureproofing at an " " "Affordable" " " entry point to AM5 socket
- tons of features (OC, EXPO, storage, fan profiles etccccc)
- solid hardware compatibility (high speed DDR5, mass storage interfaces, PCI-E 5)
- good looking piece of hardware, high build quality and attention to detail
The Bad:
- Bios UI is... unforgiving, at least having never owned an ASRock board
- you will reminisce about MSI's bios interface then remember the AM5 MSI reviews
- you will be visiting the Bios a LOT to get the most out of your system
- while in the Bios you will realize this is the real OS you were always meant to be using all along
- you will visit Amazon.com from the Bios just to review this board
- the color isn't really white, its more silver for the heatsinks and like a weird matte white backplate
The Ugly:
My experience and expectations from this product:
Migrated old Win10 install with all data from an older Z390 Intel system. It both worked without a Bios update, and a fresh Bios was already available from ASRock by the time I received the item. Aside from minor self-induced setup hick-ups the motherboard has been an absolute beast seamlessly handling all of my old data and combination of old and new hardware. Given this is an X870 board I have high expectations for AM5 and PCI-E 5 compatibility and expect to upgrade the CPU and GPU a few years down the line.
reviews.author: Art

reviews.title: Poor company support ASROCK...
reviews.comment:
The motherboard itself was fine, it ran for approx 6 weeks in a new build, but then one night the customer was going to bed, and let the computer run updates as he went to bed. The next morning, the power had went out during the updates, including a BIOS update, and the BIOS was damaged and could not be reflashed. The company ASRock did indeed honor the warranty.  However, I have been waiting about 8 weeks!!!! for my replacement!
Update:  ASROCK at last sent a motherboard to me, and it was my old board! It was not a new replacement , the board would not post ( obviously it was the same old , bad board)  Stay clear of this board or JUST ASROCK all together!  I at first gave this situation 4 stars ...I revise it now to 1 star...if I could give zero stars I would.
reviews.author: B. Gill

reviews.title: Rendimiento excepcional y estabilidad total para la serie 8000 (AM5) - ¡Ideal para setups con iGPU!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/F1b0+az7h-L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51SolMlw7RL._SY256.jpg "Después de utilizar esta ASRock X870 Pro RS durante aproximadamente un año con un Ryzen 5 8600G, puedo decir que es una placa base sólida, estable y con un diseño que cumple lo que promete. Mi experiencia ha sido excelente, especialmente en el apartado térmico: en reposo se mantiene alrededor de los 27 °C y durante sesiones de juego ronda apenas los 35 °C, lo cual demuestra una gestión de temperaturas sobresaliente.
Puntos clave de mi configuración:
Memoria RAM: La utilizo con un kit de 32 GB (2x16GB) a 6000 MT/s. Gracias al perfil AMD EXPO, la placa reconoció la velocidad a la primera sin complicaciones.
Estabilidad y Voltajes: He realizado un ajuste fino de voltajes (Undervolt) y Curve Optimizer, logrando que el sistema sea una roca. El SoC Voltage se mantiene estable en 1.250 V, lo que garantiza seguridad para el controlador de memoria y temperaturas controladas incluso bajo estrés.
Gráficos Integrados: Actualmente la uso sin tarjeta dedicada, aprovechando al máximo la iGPU del procesador. He asignado 8 GB de VRAM desde la BIOS y el sistema se comporta de manera impecable tanto en tareas diarias como en juegos y streaming con OBS.
BIOS y Montaje: El montaje fue muy sencillo y no tuve problemas de compatibilidad. Actualmente utilizo la versión de BIOS 3.4 (31/07/2024), la cual ha corregido detalles de estabilidad iniciales y funciona de maravilla.
Otros detalles:
Audio y Red: El audio integrado es limpio, sin ruidos eléctricos, y la conexión de red es muy estable. Aunque mi modelo no incluye Wi-Fi de fábrica, utilizo un adaptador USB y no he tenido cortes.
Conectividad de video (Importante): Un detalle a tener en cuenta antes de comprar es que el panel trasero incluye HDMI 2.1, pero en mi experiencia personal es vital revisar las salidas según tu monitor (este modelo específico prioriza HDMI).
Velocidad de arranque: Gracias a la opción 'Memory Context Restore' en la BIOS, el PC inicia y llega al escritorio en segundos, evitando los largos tiempos de entrenamiento de memoria comunes en la plataforma AM5.
En resumen, es una placa base fantástica si buscas estabilidad para la plataforma AM5, especialmente si planeas exprimir las capacidades de overclocking ligero o undervolting para mejorar la eficiencia del sistema."
reviews.author: William S.

reviews.title: Good, But One Major Caveat
reviews.comment: Nice quality board for the price. Has all the features I'm looking for. However... My 4090 covered up the only PCI slot, which I was planning on using for my Wi-Fi card... I did not have this issue with my previous board (Intel Z790). Despite that nuisance, it still is a good board. I personally like the ASRock UEFI too.
